question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Calm
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"calm"** means a state of peace and tranquillity; it refers to being free from agitation or excitement. (शांत)

 
 
• **Example: **She remained **calm** despite the chaos around her.
 
 
 
• **"Upset" **refers to a state of being emotionally disturbed or agitated, often due to stress or worry. (उदास)
 
 
• **Example: **He was visibly **upset** after hearing the bad news.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'calm' **is **'upset'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Urban **(शहरी): Relating to, or characteristic of a city or town.

 
 
• **Example:** **Urban** areas are often more crowded than rural ones.
 
 
 
• **Impressed **(प्रभावित): To feel admiration or respect for something or someone.
 
 
• **Example: **She was **impressed **by his dedication to his work.
 
 
 
• **Quiet** (शांत): Making little or no noise.
 
 
• **Example:** The library was so** quiet** you could hear a pin drop.
